name: time_from_enquiry_to_won_by_source
description: How many days it takes a won deal to close, by lead source — the typical time, the fastest and slowest, and how many closed the same day. Split two ways: what a REP recorded in the lead source picklist, and what the SYSTEM recorded (website form, webchat, enquiries@ inbox, Crittall email upload, or created by hand). Use for 'how long does it take to win a deal', 'which sources close fastest', 'how long is our sales cycle', 'do website leads close quicker than referrals', 'what is the time from enquiry to sale'. Won deals only — time-to-win has no meaning for a deal that has not been won, so this is not a conversion measure. A wide gap between fastest and slowest means the source brings two different kinds of customer, which is worth saying. CRITICAL: a deal appears once in each split, so never total across both — report one at a time and say which.

params.name: split
params.description: Which view of source to report: 'rep' for what a rep entered, 'system' for what the CRM recorded. Almost always worth setting — the two are not comparable.

params.name: source
params.description: Narrow to one source, e.g. 'webchat' or 'referral'.

params.name: min_won
params.description: Only sources with at least this many wins. Use to drop sources with too few wins to read a median from.
